_comment: Static reference doc only - not read at runtime. The manager (operator_dag_manager.py) uses the Python constants in operator360/utils/pipeline_status.py as the source of truth.

layer1.expected_output: per-category valid/invalid verdict, computed from each feature task's S3-reported status (all non-skipped features must succeed)

layer2.expected_output: per-category valid/invalid verdict, intersected with layer1's valid_categories

layer3.expected_output: category risk scores for valid categories, plus a final risk_score only if all 5 category scores ran
